about_the_game:
Blast through the stars in this fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter where no two runs are ever the same. Pilot your ship against relentless waves of enemies, gather powerful upgrades, and evolve into unstoppable forms as you fight for survival across the galaxy.

Choose your path each run: will you focus on overwhelming firepower, unbreakable defenses, or clever control abilities? With every victory, new challenges emerge, pushing your reflexes and strategy to the limit.

Face off against epic boss fights that will test your skills, pattern recognition, and upgrade choices. Each boss brings unique mechanics and escalating intensity, making every encounter unforgettable.

Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op, combining your strengths to overcome impossible odds. Adapt, survive, and dominate in an ever-changing battlefield where every decision shapes your fate.

Features

  • ⚡ Fast-paced rogue-lite combat – Every run brings fresh upgrades, enemy formations, and challenges.

  • 🚀 Ship evolution system – Level up to unlock new ship forms and devastating abilities.

  • 🛡️ Dozens of upgrades & boosts – Mix and match offensive, defensive, and utility powers.

  • 👾 Epic boss fights – Battle massive enemies with unique attack patterns and mechanics.

  • 🤝 Solo or co-op – Fly alone or with a friend to double the chaos.

  • 🌌 Endless replayability – Procedurally generated enemy waves and upgrades keep every run unique.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple Silicon (M1/M2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or Apple Silicon integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
